summary: The RPM installation guide covers requirements and processes for installing AAP. The RPM installer was deprecated in 2.5 and will be removed in 2.7; in 2.6 it is supported on RHEL 9 to support migrations to supported topologies.
questions: Is the RPM installer deprecated in AAP 2.6?
When will the AAP RPM installer be removed?
Can I still install AAP 2.6 with RPMs?
